origin: Rifad-owned visual system evolved through owner-reviewed POS passes; official Rifad brand assets remain the brand source.
purpose: Keep implemented POS visual and interaction rules explicit while the design system is still being validated.

typography.numericEmphasis: Use heavier weight and larger optical scale for totals, change, tendered money and operational counters.
typography.humanViewingRule: Judge readable size from normal cashier viewing distance, not design-tool zoom or screenshot symmetry.

responsiveQa.rule: Change composition, column count, wrapping, scrolling or secondary content before shrinking important cashier controls below practical touch size.

dataTraceability.rule: Any new visible durable POS field or canonical label updates the register in the same product/implementation change.

changeRule: Add or change tokens only through an approved product/visual decision linked to affected screen/flow IDs; do not let token changes silently modify business behavior.
